biography.value:
Description

This huge, serpentine, creature has four angry fiery snake-like heads that rise from its sleek body. With varying hues of red and stripes of black, this creature has fins atop its many heads that would speak of it being aquatic, if not for the colouration reminding you of lava.

Defense

AC 18, touch 9; flat-footed 17 (+1 dex, +9 natural, -2 size)

hp 94 [133] (7d12+56); Fast Healing 8 [4 heads]

Fort +11, Ref +8, Will +8

Immune Paralysis, Sleep

Resist Fire 10, ice 50%

Weakness Water

Offense

Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft.

Melee 4 Bites +10 (2d6+7), Tail Slap +5 (1d8+5)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Pounce, 4 Breath Weapons (15-ft. cone, DC 19, 3d4 fire, usable every 1d4 rounds)

Statistics

Str 20, Dex 12, Con 22, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 9

Base Atk +7; CMB +14; CM 25 (can't be trip)

Feats Combat Reflexes, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Toughness

Skills Perception +13, Swim +12; Racial Modifier +2 Perception

SQ Hydra Traits, Pyric Bulwark, Fast Healing

description.value: A pyrohydra's fast healing ability is double to its current number of heads. A pyrohydra loses all fast healing when it is reduced to a single head.

effect: Once per round: 8, 6, 4, or 0 at one head.

description.value: Any critical hit has a 75% chance to sever a head. You cannot sever the last head but pyrohydra loses its fast healing if they only have one head remaining. A pyrohydra can't attack with a severed head, but takes no other penalties. A pyrohydra also loses one of its breath weapons per head lost.

effect: Confirmed critical: [[1d100]]; 01-75 severs one head except the last.

description.value: Once per day as an immediate action, a pyrohydra can become immune to magical damage for one round, must have at least two heads to use this ability and those two heads must channel this effect until the end of the round, while channeling, each other head may be used to perform an attack or a breath weapon.
